playlists.title: Playlists
playlists.intro: A playlist loops: every page or image stays on screen for the set time, and after the last one it starts again.
playlists.name: Name
playlists.durationHelp: Empty duration = the playlist default (per page for PDF and PowerPoint). Videos play to their end.
playlists.noItems: The playlist is empty. Add media.
playlists.notReady: Still processing or failed; it is skipped.

faculties.title: Faculties
faculties.name: Name
faculties.empty: No faculties yet. Add the first one.

displays.title: Displays
displays.empty: Your faculty has no displays yet. IT pairs the displays.
displays.emptySuper: No paired displays yet. Open /player on a display and enter its code above.
displays.offlineCommand: Display “{{name}}” is not connected; the command was not sent.
displays.pairHint: On the display, open http://<server>/player. It shows a 6-character code; enter it here.
displays.name: Display name
displays.paired: Display “{{name}}” is paired and starts playing.
displays.setupUrlHint: If the display forgets its pairing after a restart, type this address into the display’s browser settings:
displays.newTokenConfirm: Issue a new address for “{{name}}”? The old one stops working and the display returns to pairing until you enter the new one.
displays.revokeConfirm: Remove display “{{name}}”? It returns to the pairing screen.

schedules.title: Schedule: {{name}}
schedules.intro: During these times the display plays the chosen playlist instead of its default. If times overlap, the higher priority wins (equal: the newer entry). Times are in the server’s local time.
schedules.empty: No entries: the display always plays its default playlist.
schedules.allDayHint: Same start and end time = the whole day (24 hours).
schedules.overnightHint: The end is before the start: the entry runs past midnight and ends the next day. Days refer to the start day.
schedules.priorityHint: The higher priority wins when entries overlap.

announcements.title: University announcements
announcements.intro: University content for all or selected faculties and displays. Mix adds it to the display’s loop; takeover temporarily replaces everything else. Faculties see this on their displays but cannot change it.
announcements.needPlaylist: First create a university playlist (Playlists → Owner: University).
announcements.name: Name

modeHelp.takeover: replaces all content on the display while active

announcements.timeHint: Times are in the server’s local time. Without an end it runs until you end it.
